Game Overview

In Goods Sort Puzzle, the core idea is straightforward: step into a vibrant world of strategic sorting. Swipe to group identical items and watch them vanish in a satisfying crunch. Customize your space with the innovative DIY locker system, creating a personalized puzzle paradise. Enjoy immersive challenges that delight and relax in this engaging match-and-sort adventure.
